science.title: Expedition to Hess Rise in the Northwest Pacific begins
science.description: May 18, 2026/Kiel. On Friday, the research vessel SONNE set sail from Yokohama, Japan, on a research expedition to the Northwest Pacific. The destination of Expedition SO320/1 is the so-called Hess Rise—one of the largest and, at the same time, least explored volcanic plateaus in the world. Under the leadership of the GEOMAR Helmholtz Centre for Ocean Research, the geological origin and structure of the more than 100-million-year-old underwater plateau will be investigated using geophysical methods.
